description: Logística Reversa (SEMA_2024) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A Lei Estadual nº 16.032/2016, que institui a Política Estadual de Resíduos Sólidos do Ceará (PERS/CE), estabelece em seu artigo 33 a logística reversa como instrumento essencial para a efetivação da responsabilidade compartilhada pelo ciclo de vida dos produtos, assegurando a atuação integrada de fabricantes, importadores, distribuidores, comerciantes, consumidores e do poder público de maneira ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Logística Reversa, Resíduos Sólidos, Ciclo de vida dos produtos. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
